metadata.mechanics: Any participant can then spend 1 Mind to draw a slip from the husk of the box after a short prayer. If it is a secret, the viewer knows the secret and cannot ever be forced via Malicious Discussion to disclose where the secret came from. If the participant draws a skill they may choose to spend the required experience points to learn the skill and add it to their sheet immediately.
metadata.notes: Optionally, game runners may be informed up to 1 month ahead of time and may choose to add skills and secrets to the box.
metadata.requirementsToUse: Lore: Faith - Common OR Profession Saint. Must be Inducted to Telling Visonaries
metadata.validTargetDescription: 5+ Targets Inducted into the Telling Visionaries.
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: The Scrambled Signals were the channels that the pre-fall youth were not supposed to see. This Benediction allows participants (at least 5 Inducted members of the faith) to write a secret, or spend 1 Mind to write a skill they can teach, on a slip of paper OOC and drop that paper into the husk of a Visions Box.
